meta.subject: Lat/lng lookup for the platform's known service cities, used for radius search
meta.note: City-centroid coordinates only (not street-level), sourced from public geographic reference data. Sufficient for a city-radius filter; not precise enough for anything finer. A city not listed here gets no lat/lng at registration and is excluded from radius search but still matches on the plain-text location filter. Add a geocoding API before expanding this list much further.
meta.scope: Matches the platform's existing CITIES list in src/data.js
